description: Returns a live Jupiter quote for buying a Backed xStock (tokenized US stock) with USDC on Solana: expected shares, minimum shares at the given slippage, price impact and route. For orders of $200 or more it adds sizeCost: how much more per share the order costs than a $100 buy. It also returns an entry-timing signal comparing the xStock's live premium or discount to the underlying NYSE price against its own trailing history in the same market regime (good-entry / fair / rich-wait, with a confidence level and a plain-language note). Read-only; creates no transaction.

ticker.description: US ticker like NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, SPY

name: quote_tokenized_stock

available.description: false when the ticker is not supported or no route exists

quote.description: Expected output, price per share, price impact and route

sizeCost.description: Extra cost of this order size versus a $100 reference order

timing.description: Entry-timing signal: on-chain premium versus the real stock against its own history
